body: Vision-language models (VLMs) have been widely adopted for document parsing and optical character recognition (OCR), as they can accurately extract page-level elements. However, downstream applications such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) also require coherent document-level structure. Although these models indicate heading levels using different numbers of preceding ``#'' symbols, page-by-page prediction often lacks document-level consistency. In practice, input-resolution and context-length constraints make it infeasible for a VLM to jointly process all page images in documents containing tens or hundreds of pages. To address this limitation, we propose a VLM-based framework that incrementally reconstructs heading hierarchies with a level-wise multimodal memory. The memory retains a compact subset of all previously processed pages, selected by anchors. Our framework supports flexible anchor selection, and in this work we select the most recent node at each level, allowing the VLM to observe the visual, textual, and layout patterns of headings at every level. For comprehensive evaluation, we also introduce the Complex and Long Document Heading Hierarchy Reconstruction Benchmark (CLDoc-HHRBench), comprising 250 documents and 11,212 pages with expert-verified annotations. Experiments on CLDoc-HHRBench and three existing benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
summaryZh: 针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在处理长文档时难以保持全局层级一致性的问题，本文提出了一种基于层级多模态记忆的增量重建框架。该方法通过锚点选择机制保留关键页面信息，有效克服了输入分辨率和上下文长度限制。此外，作者发布了 CLDoc-HHRBench 基准测试，包含 250 份专家标注的长文档，为评估文档解析与结构化能力提供了重要参考，在提升 RAG 系统文档理解精度方面具有显著价值。

glossary.explanationZh: 视觉语言模型，能够同时处理图像和文本信息的模型。
检索增强生成，通过外部知识库检索提升模型生成质量的技术。
标题层级，文档中各级标题的逻辑结构关系。
多模态记忆，用于存储和检索跨页面视觉与文本信息的机制。
